record.paper_title: Initial boundary value problem for Korteweg-de Vries equation: a review and open problems
record.context_brief: Nonlinear KdV with matched derivative boundary data
record.original_question: For the nonlinear finite-interval Korteweg-de Vries IBVP u_t + u u_x + u_xxx = 0 on 0 < x < L, with initial data u(x,0) = phi(x) and boundary conditions u(0,t) = 0, u(L,t) = 0, and u_x(0,t) = u_x(L,t), is the nonlinear problem well-posed in H^s(0,L) for some Sobolev exponent s? The source notes that the associated linear problem is well-posed forward and backward in time, but states that the nonlinear well-posedness question is still unknown.

evidence.quote: However, the following problem is still unknown: Is the nonlinear IBVP (4.23) well-posed in the space Hs (0,L) for some s ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the initial-boundary value problem for the Korteweg–de Vries equation on the finite interval (0,L):
   u_t + u u_x + u_{xxx} = 0,  for 0 < x < L, t > 0,
   u(x,0) = φ(x),  for 0 < x < L,
   u(0,t) = 0,  u(L,t) = 0,  u_x(0,t) = u_x(L,t),  for t > 0.

The associated linear problem (with the nonlinear term u u_x removed) is known to be well-posed both forward and backward in time on H^s(0,L) for suitable s.

Question: Does there exist a Sobolev exponent s ∈ ℝ and a function space setting in which the nonlinear initial-boundary value problem above is (locally or globally) well-posed in H^s(0,L)? That is, determine whether for some s there exists a class of initial data φ ∈ H^s(0,L) (possibly satisfying natural compatibility conditions) for which the problem admits a unique solution depending continuously on φ.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches indicate that while a wide range of nonhomogeneous boundary conditions for the KdV equation on a finite interval have been treated (including u(0)=u(L)=0 with u_x(L)=α u_x(0) for |α|<1, treated by Caicedo–Capistrano-Filho–Zhang and others), the specific critical "matched derivative" condition u_x(0,t)=u_x(L,t) corresponds to the case α=1, which falls outside the standard energy-dissipation framework. No publication located resolves nonlinear well-posedness in H^s(0,L) for this exact boundary configuration, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Neumann boundary controllability of the KdV equation on a bounded domain
status_evidence.snippet: Studies KdV on (0,L) with Neumann-type boundary conditions including u_x(L)=α u_x(0), establishing well-posedness/controllability under restrictions on α.
status_evidence.claim: Related Neumann-type IBVPs are treated under dissipativity assumptions on α, leaving the borderline case α=1 (matched derivatives) outside the framework.

status_evidence.title: General boundary value problems of the Korteweg-de Vries equation on a bounded domain
status_evidence.snippet: Local well-posedness in H^s(0,L) is established for general nonhomogeneous boundary conditions under structural assumptions excluding the symmetric Neumann case.
status_evidence.claim: The general framework does not cover the boundary condition u_x(0,t)=u_x(L,t) with both Dirichlet endpoints zero.

status_evidence.title: Boundary controllability of the Korteweg-de Vries equation: The Neumann case
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2023) work continues to investigate the critical/Neumann boundary configurations for KdV on (0,L).
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing investigation of borderline boundary conditions indicates the matched-derivative nonlinear well-posedness question is not yet settled.
